caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: They never finished it. Something is still building.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: The sky is darker over it. Even the corona looks tired.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: A whole city under the water, and they built on top of it.

voice.speaker: VOICE
voice.text: You have stopped the work. You have not stopped the reason for it.

voice2.speaker: VOICE
voice2.text: Every living thing burns a little of the light that is left. Mine do not.

voice3.speaker: VOICE
voice3.text: Look at the sun. Then tell me I am wrong.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: Maybe the light is going. That was never yours to decide for us.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: The Oracle wanted everyone still. So do you. Neither of you asked.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: You put a price on everyone and never asked if they'd sell.

orion.speaker: ORION
orion.text: I cannot tell you it is wrong. I can tell you it never asked.

orion2.speaker: ORION
orion2.text: It is certain. I told you to watch the certain ones.

caelen.speaker: CAELEN
caelen.text: The Foundry measured the light for years. Now they'll hear what was being built while they counted.

caelen_trusted.speaker: ORION
caelen_trusted.text: I will walk beside you, as far as they let me.

caelen_watched.speaker: ORION
caelen_watched.text: I will walk where you can see me. That has not changed.

seraphine.speaker: SERAPHINE
seraphine.text: Home, with a Foundry machine beside me and the old records in my bag. Let them sing or not.

seraphine_trusted.speaker: ORION
seraphine_trusted.text: If they do not open the doors, I will wait outside with you.

seraphine_watched.speaker: ORION
seraphine_watched.text: Keep watching me. They will be watching both of us.

nimue.speaker: NIMUE
nimue.text: Pass it down every route: the way is open. Another road nobody charges for.

nimue_trusted.speaker: ORION
nimue_trusted.text: Then someone should walk it first. I can.

nimue_watched.speaker: ORION
nimue_watched.text: Send me down it first, if you still want to watch.
